name: woocommerce-product-list-scraper
description: List public products from a WooCommerce store URL and export them to a CSV file.
author: Copilot

store_url.description: The public URL of the WooCommerce store, for example https://example.com

output_file.description: The output CSV filename, for example products.csv

output.description: Path to the generated CSV file containing the discovered products.

notes: This tool works best with public product pages or public WooCommerce APIs.
Stores that require login or WooCommerce API credentials will need authentication to return the full product catalog.
